source:
@@U03103@@
Can't say exactly. But probably if you ask around you'll find her. Hurry, and before dawn you can check at all the fires. A man who has dared descend to the Mothers has nothing more to fear.

@@U03105@@
Since I have my own reasons for being here, I suggest each of us search out his own adventure among the fires. When it’s time to reunite, our little friend here will let his glass shine out and sound.

@@U03107@@
This is how it will sound and flash.

@@U03108@@
(The glass sounds and shines powerfully.)

@@U03109@@
Off we go now in search of new wonders.

@@U03110@@
(Exeunt 梅菲斯特 and 荷蒙库鲁斯 in opposite directions.)

@@U03112@@
(Alone.)

@@U03113@@
Where is she? But why ask! If this isn’t the same soil her foot touched, or the wave that swirled at her feet, it’s the air, at least, the air that spoke her speech. Here, by a miracle, here I am, in Greece! No sooner I touched the ground, I knew where I was: new life surged, warming me after sleep, like an 安泰俄斯 of the spirit. No matter how strange what I may encounter, I'll explore this labyrinth of flames in all earnestness.

@@U03114@@
(Exit.)
translation:
@@U03103@@
说不准。但如果你四处打听，你可能会找到她。快点，天亮之前你就可以检查所有的火了。一个敢于下降到母亲身边的人就没有什么可害怕的了。

@@U03105@@
因为我来这里有自己的原因，所以我建议我们每个人都在大火中寻找自己的冒险经历。当团聚的时候，我们的小朋友会让他的玻璃发出光芒并发出声音。

@@U03107@@
这就是它的声音和闪烁方式。

@@U03108@@
（玻璃发出强烈的声音和光芒。）

@@U03109@@
我们现在出发去寻找新的奇迹。

@@U03110@@
（梅菲斯特和荷蒙库鲁斯向相反方向下。）

@@U03112@@
（独自一人。）

@@U03113@@
她在哪儿？但为什么要问！如果这不是她脚踩过的土壤，也不是在她脚边旋转的波浪，那么至少是空气，是她说话的空气。奇迹，我在这里，在希腊！我一落地，就知道自己在哪里：新的生命涌动，让睡后的我感到温暖，就像精神的安泰俄斯一样。无论遇到多么奇怪的事情，我都会认真地探索这个火焰迷宫。

@@U03114@@
（退出。）
